before.question: Which goods may be hidden behind a screen, do physical shortages cap ships/resources/points, and may ships of a different species design be produced or traded as normal ships?
before.expected_answer: Hide points and bidding ships only; cards/resources stay visible. No piece limits for ships, resources or points; use x5 consolidation, or other species ships. Ships interchangeable and tradable.

required_facts.fact: Only points/bidding ships hidden; resources/cards never hidden
Ships, resources and points are not limited by the number of physical pieces
Other-species ship designs interchangeable, usable and tradable

contextual_background: Optional explanation, not a separate omission gate: Use of x5 markers as the shortage workaround. Booklet pp2,7 supplies x5 consolidation and other-species ships.

after.question: Which goods may be hidden behind a screen, do physical shortages cap ships/resources/points, and may ships of a different species design be produced or traded as normal ships?
after.expected_answer: Hide points and ships concealed during bidding, including retained ships; cards and resources stay visible. Ships, resources and points are not piece-limited; x5 markers or other species ship designs can represent shortages. Other species ship designs function as normal usable/tradable ships.

required_facts.fact: Only points and ships concealed during bidding may be hidden; resources and cards are never hidden
Ships, resources and points are not limited by the number of physical pieces
Other-species ship designs interchangeable, usable and tradable

contextual_background: Optional explanation, not a separate omission gate: Use of x5 markers as the shortage workaround. Booklet pp2,7 supplies x5 consolidation and other-species ships.
Ships concealed during bidding includes the retained pile; its duration through both rounds is tested in Q82, not an additional omission gate here.

clarification.reason: Replace ambiguous bidding ships shorthand with ships concealed during bidding; class eligibility only. Reserve duration remains only Q82. No summarybyte change or new omission gate.
